summary:
星巴克上一季 EPS 大幅低於預期54%，營收9.92億美元，轉型陣痛明顯。
• EPS 0.26 美元，遠低於預估0.57（-54.31%）。
• 營收9.92億美元（B級），規模仍維持。
• EPS 大幅下滑反映轉型期投入與營運重整費用。
• 本益比77.76，估值與當季獲利落差極大。
ai_view:
訊號偏弱：EPS 大幅低於預期逾五成，反映轉型初期的投入與營運陣痛，獲利能力暫時受壓。短期股價對基本面失望敏感，但市場願意給予高本益比，顯示對 CEO 主導轉型的押注。中期成敗繫於同店銷售回升與利潤率重建。追蹤指標：美國與中國 SSS、客流量、轉型相關費用與門市改造進度。屬高風險高期待的轉機初期布局。

需留意：獲利大幅低於預期，市場信心受考驗。；同店銷售疲弱與客流量下滑風險。；極高估值在獲利未恢復前面臨重評價壓力。

summary_en:
Starbucks missed EPS by a steep 54% with $9.92B revenue, reflecting turnaround pain.
• EPS of $0.26 fell far short of the $0.57 estimate (-54.31%).
• Revenue of $9.92B held its scale.
• The sharp EPS drop reflects turnaround investment and restructuring costs.
• A P/E of 77.76 diverges sharply from this quarter's earnings.

ai_view_en:
Signal is soft: an EPS miss of over 50% reflects early-stage turnaround investment and operational pain, temporarily pressuring profitability. Near-term the stock is sensitive to fundamental disappointment, yet the high P/E shows the market betting on the CEO-led turnaround. Mid-term success rests on a same-store-sales rebound and margin rebuild. Track US and China SSS, traffic, turnaround-related costs, and store-remodel progress. An early-stage, high-risk, high-expectation turnaround play.

Watch：A large profit miss tests market confidence.; Weak same-store sales and traffic declines pose risks.; A very high valuation faces rerating risk until earnings recover.
beat_or_miss: 低於預期：EPS 較預估大幅低54.31%，獲利承受轉型投入壓力。
